description: A screenshot of a Windows "Open" dialog, titled "Öffnen", depicting the selection of Copernicus Land Monitoring Service (CLMS) High Resolution Layer (HRL) Imperviousness Density (IMD) raster data files. The user is browsing within the directory `IMD_2018_010m_al_03035_v020\DATA`, with "Downloads" highlighted in the left navigation pane. The main file view lists several `.tif` files, all prefixed `IMD_2018_010m_E...N..._03035_v020.tif`. The filenames visible include: `IMD_2018_010m_E50N21_03035_v020.tif`, `IMD_2018_010m_E51N18_03035_v020.tif`, `IMD_2018_010m_E51N19_03035_v020.tif`, `IMD_2018_010m_E51N20_03035_v020.tif`, `IMD_2018_010m_E51N21_03035_v020.tif`, `IMD_2018_010m_E51N22_03035_v020.tif`, `IMD_2018_010m_E52N18_03035_v020.tif`, `IMD_2018_010m_E52N19_03035_v020.tif`, `IMD_2018_010m_E52N20_03035_v020.tif`, and `IMD_2018_010m_E52N21_03035_v020.tif`. The "Dateiname" (Filename) field partially displays `"IMD_2018_010m_E52N21_03035_v020.tif" "IMD_2018_...` indicating multiple files might be selected or referenced. The file type filter is set to "Benutzerdefinierte Dateien (*.tif)". Action buttons are "Öffnen" (Open) and "Abbrechen" (Cancel). This screenshot illustrates step 3 of data ingestion for HRL Imperviousness (IMD) data for Albania (indicated by "al" in the path) for the year 2018.
